correctness.rationale: Solve the actual two-stage tableau at each x in [1/2,1] for yprime=-lambda y. One-step multiplier R_x(-r)=[2+(4x-2)r+(2x²-4x+1)r²]/[2(1+rx)²]. The denominator is positive; q_r convex and its two endpoint values and roots x±=1−1/r±sqrt((r−2)/(2r)) prove p=0 for r<=2, p=1−2/r+sqrt(2−4/r) for 2<r<1+sqrt3, p=1 thereafter. At thresholds zero-sign sampling sets have measure zero. Fresh independent x samples imply Binomial(N,p) reversal count, parity formula, all-positive probability (1-p)^N; p(2+delta)~sqrt(delta) yields N^-2 Poisson(sqrt(c)). Independent rational amplifier derivation and six finite sign-fraction probes corroborate, not substitute for analytic proof.
